info.title: SiteCheck API
info.description: Pay-per-call tools for AI agents: image generation, speech-to-text, text-to-speech, embeddings, LLM chat, website audits and contact enrichment, web page to Markdown reader, PDF to text, sitemap URLs, tech stack detection, translation, exchange rates, e-mail pre-check, domain RDAP/DNS lookup, Solana token checks, trending tokens and wallet holdings, plus business and compliance data (EU VAT/VIES, IBAN, LEI/GLEIF, US recalls, OSHA/EPA violations, UK insolvency notices). Also: SEO metadata, link checking, redirect chains, security headers, mail DNS (SPF, DMARC, DKIM), QR codes, language detection, photo EXIF, identifier validation, image OCR, SEC filings, SEC financials, Congress bills, macro rates, UK company data, GitHub repo stats, Hacker News, Wikipedia, gas prices, Solana swap quotes, ERC-20 token checks, ENS names, EVM wallet balances, EVM balances, transactions and contract calls, Solana transactions and accounts, crypto prices, candles and order books, DeFi TVL, yields and stablecoins, SEC insider trades, weather, geocoding and holidays, IP owners and postcodes, npm, PyPI and crates package data and vulnerabilities, GitHub profiles, arXiv papers and DOIs, structured extraction, summaries, sentiment and reranking, HTML tables and RSS feeds, Bitcoin fees, addresses and transactions, Bitcoin address balances, Bitcoin transaction status, EVM calldata decoding, verified EVM contracts, Hyperliquid perpetual markets, Hyperliquid account positions, Polymarket odds, crypto fear and greed, DeFi fees, DEX volume, company registries of four countries, ISIN, CUSIP and ticker lookup, SEC full-text search, SEC 8-K events, FDA drug labels, FDA adverse event counts, clinical trials, PubMed articles, US federal grants, EU public tenders, NPI provider lookup, US address geocoding, USGS earthquakes, NWS weather alerts, sunrise and moon times, time zone conversion, distance and bearing, GDACS disaster alerts, llms.txt checks, AI crawler access, tracker and cookie audits, certificate transparency, site logos and icons, GitHub releases, GitHub issues, Stack Overflow answers, read-only Wikidata queries, text moderation, image descriptions, text classification, named entity extraction, PII redaction, phone number checks, cron explanations, JSON Schema validation, whale transfers, SSL certificate expiry, Markdown to HTML, PageSpeed scores, Product Hunt launches, sanctions screening (OFAC, EU, UN, UK), flight fare search, YouTube transcripts, speech to text from media links. Plus prediction-market search, briefs, quotes and unsigned buy transactions, powered by Panta. Payment: x402, USDC on Base, Solana or Arc. No signup, no API key.
info.x-guidance: Call any /api/* operation without payment first. The 402 answer's PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (base64 JSON, x402 v2) lists one "exact" USDC option per network (Base, Solana, Arc). Sign one with an x402 client and repeat the request with the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. Payment settles only when the call succeeds.

402.description: Payment required (x402). The PAYMENT-REQUIRED header lists one option per network.

id.description: Panta market id (the market's event address, base58), from GET /api/markets

amountUsdc.description: USDC to spend, as a decimal string, e.g. "5.00"

wallet.description: The buyer's Solana wallet (base58). It pays and signs; SiteCheck never does.
